title.en: Allowing Pasture Lessees to Use Their Pasture Lands for Agricultural Purposes Under Certain Conditions

text.en:
Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, a pasture lessee or permittee is
hereby allowed to devote his pasture land for agricultural purposes; Provided, That a certification of the
Secretary of Agriculture is first obtained that the land is suited for agricultural purposes.

In case the Secretary of Agriculture certifies that the land is more suitable to agriculture than for
pasture purposes and upon proper application by the pasture permittee or lessees, the Secretary of Natural
Resources shall issue the necessary order declassifying the land, subject to the approval thereof by the

After the reclassification of the pasture land into an agricultural land, the same shall be reappraised
for the purpose of determining the reasonable rental thereof. The pasture permittee or lessee may be allowed
to lease the same, subject to the limitations provided in the Constitution, the Public Land Act and other
existing laws, rules and regulations.

All provisions of existing laws, orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 29th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
